=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- changelog.d/10019-poller-mock-store-lock.md:2 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog (and the fixture comment at tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py lines 670-672) says the lock protects parallel test shards. `_run_poller` uses a per-run temp store, so shards never share GH_MOCK_STORE.
  WHY: The lock only serializes overlapping fakes inside one poller run, so the stated cause is wrong and misleads maintainers. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 said NIT, gemini and glm said MAJOR. The highest is used.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:670-672 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The code comment "parallel shards on a busy runner" repeats the incorrect cross-shard claim.
  WHY: The per-run temp store (line 1226) means shards never contend, so the comment documents an impossible cause. Severity disagreement: NIT versus MAJOR. The highest is used.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:709-718 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The timeout branch of `_mock_store_lock_acquire` returns at line 715 without setting GH_MOCK_STORE_LOCK_HELD. Child fakes, such as the git fake re-invoking itself per refspec at line 3570, each re-wait the full timeout.
  WHY: The wait is bounded, but the fail-open path can stack repeated 30-second stalls.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
